final: SELECT AVG(avg_band_usage), AVG(record_count) FROM (SELECT t.observstation, o.weathprofile, AVG(t.bandusagepct) AS avg_band_usage, COUNT(*) AS record_count FROM telescopes AS t JOIN observatories AS o ON t.observstation = o.observstation WHERE t.pointaccarc > 4.86 GROUP BY t.observstation, o.weathprofile)
